newsitem.title: USA: True North said in talks to buy firm.
newsitem.headline: True North said in talks to buy firm.

text.p: True North Communications Inc is in serious discussions to buy New York-based advertising firm, Bozell, Jacobs, Kenyon & Eckhardt, an industry source said Tuesday.
"Clearly the discussions are serious," the source said.
True North, which is holding its annual meeting on Wednesday, declined to comment on reports of a possible purchase of Bozell, Jacos.
If a deal were to be reached, the source said an announcement could be made within 30 to 45 days.

"Bruce Mason has made it very clear that he would like like to have another brand or two, meaning another full agency," the source said, referring to True North Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Bruce Mason.
True North companies include Foote, Cone & Belding, the largest advertising agency in North America; Mojo; TN Technologies Inc, and Associated Communications Cos.
